shape: 3-portal sprawling arena (S + W + E gates) with center super-hub + west cluster
description: Three-portal arena. WEST CLUSTER (b4xepb west entry + 4dez0q + 31my8e + an0qy3) — 4-anchor clique at the west gate. CENTER super-hub (vejxsa, 5-way) reaches west chain (31my8e), south (atnngx, kevqow), south_inner (xzm7l9), and ksqmwe (NE bridge). South entry hub (xzm7l9) is 4-way (spawn_south + center + atnngx + kevqow + x4g2xv east). EAST CHAIN: ksqmwe → v1rib2 → s53ruq (east entry) → s4yqzh → 28p7by (S pocket chain).

traversalNotes: Direct W→S: spawn_west → west_inner → west_s → center → south_inner → spawn_south. 5 hops.
Direct W→E: spawn_west → west_inner → west_s → center → c_se → e_step → east_inner → spawn_east. 7 hops.
Direct S→E: spawn_south → south_inner → center → c_se → e_step → east_inner → spawn_east. 6 hops.
DISPATCH: center (vejxsa) is the canonical 5-way router; west_inner is the 4-way west cluster dispatcher; south_inner is the 4-way south clique.
S pocket chain (s_pocket_a → s_pocket_b) is a 2-hop dead-end off east_inner — corner objective.
e_anchor is a 1-degree dead-end off south_inner (NE corner).
